final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT c.gender AS gender, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM Invoices i JOIN Orders o ON o.order_id = i.order_id JOIN Customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.gender), s2 AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total FROM s1), s3 AS (SELECT s1.gender AS gender, s1.cnt AS cnt, (s1.cnt * 1.0) / s2.total AS ratio FROM s1 JOIN s2 ON s2.total IS NOT NULL), s4 AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM s3) SELECT s3.gender, s3.cnt, s3.ratio, s3.ratio - s4.avg_ratio FROM s3 JOIN s4 ON s4.avg_ratio IS NOT NULL WHERE s3.ratio > s4.avg_ratio
